summary:
Turn 44 reviewed the promoted-leader variant check, which extends the confirmed recovery finding to the deployed configuration.

State on entry. Claim C6-recovery-ignores-committed-reply-when-promoted has one artifact, f2523a67a7e94950b0eacff7c280a42a (executed as 4e8a4b74…), with outcome violated and oracle correspondence unreviewed. Its retained stream shows the variant's ballot arithmetic (recovery_seed with is_leader true, max_recv_ballot 5, self VBallot 6, seed ballot -1) and the resolution that follows (adopted_committed false, accept round completing, vectors_match false, all_committed_match false, applied state diverging). Claim C5 was also settled this cycle as bounded_no_violation, so the owner-alive re-proposal protection is confirmed.

Review judgement (checker_correspondence, no_issue_found). Requirement versus predicate: C6 asserts that a replica the deployment promoted to leader must adopt a reply reporting the instance COMMITTED, and the three properties assert adoption at the resolution, the recoverer-versus-peer comparison and agreement after the Commit broadcast, all evaluated on printed fields. Entry and variant legality: the master designates a leader in the shipped configuration and calls Replica.BeTheLeader on it, which sets IsLeader; makeBallot then raises the new ballot past maxRecvBallot, and startRecoveryForInstance reports that raised ballot as the replica's own VBallot, so the variant differs from the reviewed non-promoted case only in the ballot value while the comparison that skips older-vbal replies is unchanged. Oracle and identity are the same as the non-promoted artifact, including the prerequisite and instance correlation, and the harness drives the queued rounds and re-reads InstanceSpace after each delivery. Alternatives and limits: the reservation that the deployment flag might change the outcome is answered by this run; what remains is that a real ballot history is modelled as one maxRecvBallot value, that the master's promotion is a sourced premise rather than an executed step, and that the committed record is prepared. C1's confirmed scope (IsLeader false) is explicitly untouched, so this check extends the finding to the deployed variant rather than reinterpreting a confirmed result.

Remaining frontier. The scope-issue bookkeeping on the superseded C1 artifact, the unread helper surfaces (replica/sender.go, replica/mset.go, hook/), and the two paused candidates with their resume conditions. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
